notes: CABLOXX locking system for pull-outs from the Blum Catalogue and technical manual 2024/2025, printed page 594 (order information). Up to five pull-outs per locking bar; the cylinder lock is not part of the delivery. The ready-made M|M|M and C|M sets (LH 544 only) and the planning dimensions of p.595 (bar groove, drilling) are not recorded. Not verified by a person.
